entries.description: The complete Ableton Live project currently open.
A grid for launching clips and scenes in a nonlinear performance workflow.
A linear timeline for composing and editing a song.
A horizontal row of clip slots that can be launched together.
A channel that holds clips, devices, routing, and mixer controls.
A shared effects channel fed by track send controls.
The final mix channel through which the Live Set output passes.
One Session View cell that may contain and launch a clip.
A clip that references and plays sampled audio.
A clip containing notes and MIDI automation.
An instrument, audio effect, or MIDI effect in a track device chain.
One readable control or setting exposed by a device.
Track controls such as volume, pan, mute, solo, and sends.
The configured source and destination of a track's audio or MIDI signal.
Recorded changes to a parameter over musical time.
The object or time range currently selected in Live's interface.
Musical time measured in beats rather than wall-clock seconds.
A logarithmic unit commonly used for audio level or gain.
A parameter represented on a unitless zero-to-one scale.
A monotonically increasing bridge version for one Live session.
The wall-clock timestamp when an observation batch was recorded.
Whether the returned graph portion is complete or intentionally partial.
